subject: Adding json and flat integration tests (#88)
reason: The only production change is swapping valkey-search's JSON-module detection from a JSON.GET probe to a MODULE LIST scan (IsJsonModuleLoaded -> vmsdk::IsModuleLoaded), reached only by FT.CREATE ON JSON and a one-time OnLoad log line. The swap is behavior-preserving: with the JSON module loaded both builds report loaded; without it both return the identical 'JSON module is not loaded' error. A difference is observable only when valkey-json is actually loaded, but the harness loads only the two valkey-search builds into the pinned Valkey and provides no valkey-json artifact, so FT.CREATE ON JSON
